note:
Mihara: Bonding Chain — MG/Fire. Board: 1.179 HOT (mean of her 2 graded comps after the live-pool enactment — see the FIT-EXPOSED caveat). Ensnaring Chains is modeled as a LIVE stack pool (owner ruling 2026-08-13: model the stacks, do not average them), on the engine's resource-scaled DoT primitive. Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/mihara-bonding-chain.test.ts (13 tests, groups M1-M5).
RESTRAINT CHAINS: charged to 10 at battle start and refilled to 10 at each Full-Burst end after her own burst; the S1 'specific timing' attack then dumps all of them, one 50.06% hit per chain. Modeled as a 500.6% (10 x 50.06) flatDamage dump on a passive at battle start and again on fullBurstEnd — she is the team's Burst III, so Full-Burst end coincides with her burst end.
ENSNARING CHAINS: a sustained-damage DoT capped at 20 stacks, fed by the Restraint hits and by S2's +1 per 40 normals during Full Burst. Her burst CANCELS Ensnaring to 0; it rebuilds +10 from the Restraint dump at the following FB end and +1 per 40 normals during FB windows, reaching the 20 cap before her next burst. Shipped as a LIVE pool: `resources.ensnaring` [0..20], a permanent DoT carrying `perResource {ensnaring, 25.08}` so each tick's magnitude is the CURRENT stack count x 25.08, +10 resource blocks on the two Restraint dumps, +1 on a `hitCount:40` block gated to Full Burst, and a -20 on her burst that clamps the pool to zero. There is no fitted stack number left in this file — the stack trajectory emerges from the kit's own generation and spend.
BURST — Dragging Chain mirrors the 20 Ensnaring stacks for 10s, i.e. the full 1001%/s (20 x 50.05), and cancels Ensnaring. With a live pool the no-double-count property is STRUCTURAL rather than arithmetic: the cancel zeroes the pool, the baseline DoT reads that zero and stops contributing on its own, so the window sums to exactly 1001%/s. The superseded model could not switch a static baseline off, so it shipped a 700 DELTA (1001 - 301) to subtract it — a decomposition that only held while the baseline was a constant. Removing the cancel is now the double-count counterfactual, and the spec pins it.
DoTs correctly inherit S2's stageEnter-3 sustainedDamagePct +59.98% / 10s through the Damage-Up bucket.
Her burst damage is a dot, and its kit clause is NOT one of the burst-amp literals, so the 'burstDesc is authorable on flatDamage only' engine gap is MOOT for her — there is nothing to tag and no eligibility claim to make.
NOT MODELED, by disposition: S2's 'when the skill user is incapacitated → Ensnaring +20' (defensive; the boss deals no damage) and 'when an enemy is neutralized → Restraint +1' (the boss never dies). S2's 40-normals-in-Full-Burst Ensnaring generation is a discrete hitCount:40 fbGate:'inFb' block feeding the live pool.
In a multi-B3 comp the S1 fullBurstEnd dump can over-fire, since the kit's 'if this unit has just used her Burst Skill' gate is only exact when she is the sole B3. Benign on the graded comps; recorded as a kit-status finding rather than pinned as correct.

skill2: Activates when the skill user is incapacitated. Affects targets in the Ensnaring Chains state.
Activates when an enemy is neutralized while in the Ensnaring Chains state. Affects self.

caveats: skill1: the Restraint dump's timing is kit-silent ('at a specific timing') — modeled at battle start and at Full-Burst end (⚑)

skill1: the permanent Ensnaring DoT is LIVE — `perResource {ensnaring, 25.08}` recomputes each tick from the current stack count, so there is no fitted stack number in this file. The burst ships the full kit 1001%/s and cancels the pool to zero, which is why the window sums to 1001 without a decomposition.

skill2: the 40-normals-in-Full-Burst Ensnaring generation is a real `hitCount:40` block carrying `fbGate:'inFb'` AND `countScope:'gated'` — the kit scopes the COUNTING to Full Burst ('+1 per 40 normals during Full Burst'), so out-of-window normals must not advance the counter. Without the count scope she over-generates by ~19% (127 vs 107 gains per fight), though the 20-stack cap absorbs most of it.

⚑ FIT-EXPOSED by the live pool, and this is a real residual, NOT a number to turn back. The retired 12-stack average sat BELOW what the kit's own generation produces (the pool time-averages ~13.4 stacks), so she moved 1.034 -> 1.179 HOT on her 2 graded comps when the fitted value was removed. Her measured full-burst count is unchanged (11 vs measured 11), so the movement is magnitude, not rotation. Same class as the snow-white-heavy-arms stage-entry exposure: the fitted number was absorbing an over-model elsewhere in her kit, and finding it is the follow-up. Do not restore the average.
skill2: 'when the skill user is incapacitated → Ensnaring Chains stacks ▲20' is inert — the boss deals no damage at scope lock, so she is never incapacitated.
skill2: 'when an enemy is neutralized → Restraint Chain ▲1, up to 10' is inert — the boss never dies at scope lock.

skill1: in a multi-B3 comp the fullBurstEnd Restraint dump can over-fire, because the kit's 'if this unit has just used her Burst Skill' gate is only exact when she is the sole B3. Benign on the graded comps.
